entities.name: Redshift
entities.description: A Goblin Rocketeer chief who leads his team in the Aetherdrift Grand Prix.

entities.name: Terrin
entities.description: A fighter with a dog who strikes down a ghost with his blade.

entities.name: Sektem
entities.description: A Lotusguard veteran who vows that no one dies under his watch.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A character who comments on the humanity of the Guidelight Voyagers and takes on long odds with Daretti.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A character who works with Pia and explains how Lightning Strike works.

entities.name: Chakshi
entities.description: A Dawnchaser pilgrim who follows Sundial, Dawn Tyrant.

entities.name: Sundial, Dawn Tyrant
entities.description: A tyrant creature that walks at the head of the ever-breaking day and is followed by Dawnchaser pilgrims.

entities.name: Vnwxt
entities.description: The verbose host of the Grand Prix, whose contract demands a dedicated camera on him at all times.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: An Amonkhet character who speaks of the rebirth of Amonkhet and of making peace with one's end.

entities.name: Far Fortune
entities.description: A racer who speaks of negotiation and surviving wrecks.

entities.name: Kheti
entities.description: A woman who lost everything to the Eternals and the Phyrexians and gained knowledge of death.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A racer with experience of Duskmourn who speaks of sportsmanship and death.

entities.name: Sphyr
entities.description: A Keelhauler lookout.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: A character who is horrified by a Pactdoll Terror designed for children.

entities.name: Shantanu
entities.description: A character grabbed by the Ripclaw as the Endriders chanted.

entities.name: Rido
entities.description: An Endrider racer from the dead world of Gastal.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels with Loot and joins the Grand Prix.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young rat-like being, older than nearly every living thing there, who can predict Omenpaths and whom Chandra, Jace, Pia, Vraska and Winter look after.

entities.name: Killswitch
entities.description: A goblin mechanic who finally had the right wrench for the job.

entities.name: Termin
entities.description: The Grand Prix track designer.

entities.name: Lagorin
entities.description: A character who would not lose another.

entities.name: Garima
entities.description: A designer who tests her own design.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A planeswalker who has a plan and speaks about Loot.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker worried about Loot.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An aether-seer who describes the fauna of Muraganda.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A planeswalker searching for her lost mentor.

entities.name: Speedbump
entities.description: A Rocketeer who has survived ninety-nine rocket crashes.

entities.name: Guidelight Voyagers
entities.description: A racing team of constructs stranded on Avishkar who seek a way home.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: The racing team of Avishkar who repurpose vehicles and thopters.

entities.name: Keelhaulers
entities.description: A pirate-like racing team.

entities.name: Rocketeers
entities.description: A goblin racing team that pushes the limits of kinetic energy.

entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: A racing team from the dead world of Gastal who treat racing as worship.

entities.name: Speedbrood
entities.description: A racing team of insectoid beings who seek to become speed itself.

entities.name: Fang Druids
entities.description: Druids of Muraganda who desire peace.

entities.name: Team Cloudspire
entities.description: Racers from Kylem and reigning champions of the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Alacrian Quickbeasts
entities.description: Racers who seek new alliances against unknown threats.

entities.name: Speed Demons
entities.description: Doomed souls who race in uneasy unity hoping to escape their fate.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: Racers who want to show Amonkhet is a living world.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The former rulers of Avishkar, ousted by the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: The revolution that ousted the Consulate and renamed Avishkar.

entities.name: Saurid Autocracy
entities.description: A power that regards diplomacy as a matter of power and tests the Grand Prix defenses.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the multiverse.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane where the Guidelight Voyagers were stranded and where the Grand Prix begins.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane of undeath whose champions race, and which is being reborn.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A jungle plane under falling moonfalls and home to the Fang Druids.

entities.name: Gastal
entities.description: A dead world of Fuel Wars, home to the Endriders and oil-thirsting vampires.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane where the metal is possessed.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: Home of Team Cloudspire.

entities.name: Grand Prix
entities.description: A multiplanar race.

events.summary: Terrin strikes a ghost with his blade.
events.quote: The ghost shrieked as Terrin's blade sank deep.

events.summary: The Guidelight Voyagers are stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home.
events.quote: The Guidelight Voyagers had been stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home.

events.summary: The Aether Rangers repurpose Consulate surveillance thopters to scout the track.
events.quote: The Aether Rangers repurposed thopters once used for Consulate surveillance so they could scout the track.
Garima was delighted to finally test out her design.

events.summary: Redshift tells his team to destroy the competition and they take it literally.
events.quote: Redshift told his team to destroy the competition.

events.summary: Chandra tells Loot they will make an entrance, and soon regrets it.
events.quote: In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

events.summary: The Avishkari delegation misunderstands its treaties with the Saurid Autocracy, which tests the Grand Prix's defenses.
events.quote: testing the Grand Prix's defenses is merely their way of making a counteroffer.

events.summary: Jace tries to explain his plan but lacks time.
events.quote: Unfortunately, time was in short supply.

events.summary: Mu Yanling continues searching for her lost mentor.
events.quote: The search for her lost mentor continued.

events.summary: Loot is rescued by new rescuers he prefers.
events.quote: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.

events.summary: The Indigo Revolution ousts the Consulate.
events.quote: The Indigo Revolution ousted the Consulate once and for all.

relations.quote: "But we're not most people," Pia replied.
"Launch the explosives! No, you idiot, not like that!" —Redshift, Rocketeer chief
"Loot is free to go where he wants, so let's make sure the kid gets there in one piece." —Chandra Nalaar

relations.note: Chakshi is a pilgrim following Sundial.
relations.quote: "We follow as it walks at the head of the ever-breaking day.

rejected.summary: Caelorna emerges from the water, bringing her coral depths with her.
rejected.quote: When she emerged, the coral depths she called home came with her.
